page.layout: One page of running text, one column, with no margin notes. Page number at top left. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: de Translatione reliquiarum suæ matris . Codex Vaticanus Num. 274. Constantinus Acropolita in laudatione sanctæ Theodoræ Martyris, in laudatione S. Ioannis Dama-scenì [?]. Cyrillus Scythopolitanus in vita Ioannis Episcopi, & Hesychastæ Lauræ S. Sabæ. Daniel Monachus in vita Ioannis Climaci. Demetrius Chrysolora Orat. de S. Demetrio. Euchologium Græcorum in Officio Monachorum mortuorum, In Officio Sacerdotum mortuorum. Eustratius Presbyter, Tractatu de animabus separatis. Gabriel Hymnodus Can. in S. Nicolaum . Gabriel Severus Philadelphiensis, Tractatu de Particulis, Tractatu de Differentijs Græcorum & Latinorum. Gennadius Patriarcha Constantinopolitanus pro Concilio Florentino . Georgius Grammaticus Orat. in SS. Barbaram, & Iulianam Martyres. Georgius Patriarcha Constantinopolitanus Orat. in sanctum Georgium Martyrem, Orat. in S. Dionysium Areopagitam, Orat. in S. Marinam Martyrem, Orat. in S. Euthymium Madytorum Episcopum, In vita S. Lazari Galesij. Georgius Scholarius Monachus Can. in Palamam. Gregorius Abbas in Oxia Insula, Epistola ad Alexium Porphyrogennetam. Gregorius Diaconus, & Referendarius, in laudatione S. Demetrij Martyris.

page.notes: Long s was normalised to plain s (Tranflatione, Conftantinus, Eustratius, separatis). The "ct" ligature is read as "ct". The word after "Dama-" is partly unclear, so "Damascenì" is marked [?]. Show-through from the facing page appears along the right edge and is not transcribed. The catchword "Gre-" is at the right below the last line.
